searchText: MSRP $265,765. The All-New 2027 Entegra Coach Vision XL 34B Class A Luxury RV for sale at Motor Home Specialist; the #1 Volume Selling Motor Home Dealership in the World. Features Customer Value Package Coastal Decor Combination Washer/Dryer Front Overhead Bunk More About This RV The Entegra Coach Vision XL is built for your next adventure and includes all new features such as new exterior graphics package, all new full body paint exteriors, infotainment center changed to Sony w/apple car play and android auto, solid surface counters upgraded to match in bathroom and bedroom.
